title: The Swapped Showcase Variant
intro: The shop's rare, signed comic prize has been replaced with a cheap copy, and the real one has vanished from the glass case.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was checking prices on the wall. Nothing else, I promise.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I only came in for the new issue of my favourite series, honest.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Me? I just sat in the reading corner and read the whole back issue.

suspects.name: Nell
suspects.line: I was drawing sketches by the counter. Look at my notebook!

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: I've been reorganising the back bins all morning. Ask anyone.

clues.text: Nothing was left on the glass behind the empty stand, no scribbled notes or paper scraps at all. So the culprit did not leave a sticky note behind.
The air here smells of lemon soap, but that scent is a red herring: whoever came through this spot did not carry it. The lemon soap smell can be ruled out.
The latch shows smooth fingerprints and no fabric smudges, so the thief was not wearing gloves. Glove marks are ruled out for the culprit.
A trace of sharp coffee hangs over the counter, the kind of strong brew the culprit clearly had on their breath or clothes. Keep an eye out for that smell.
